name: Stop Motion
description: The first clip is a paper cutout that jerks off the frame in choppy stop-motion steps, with a tiny new tilt and offset each step and a drop shadow, while the second cutout jerks in the same way and lands. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: steps
params.description: Number of held poses during the transition: fewer is choppier

params.name: jitter
params.description: Size of the small random tilt and offset given to the cutouts at each step

params.name: shadow
params.description: Darkness of the drop shadow the cutouts cast

params.name: back_color
params.description: Color of the background behind the cutouts

params.name: rim_color
params.description: Color of the paper rim around the cutouts
